articles.title: This Quantum Battery Charges in a Quadrillionth of a Second — and Could Last for Years
articles.summary: Australian researchers built the first quantum battery that uses superabsorption to charge almost instantly. A minute of charging could power devices for years, but decoherence remains a major hurdle.

articles.title: Mortal Kombat II Has No Post-Credits Scene — Here's Your Spoiler-Free Guide
articles.summary: Despite franchise filmmaking trends, Mortal Kombat II contains zero credits scenes. Fans can leave as soon as the credits roll without missing any teases for a potential third installment.

articles.title: Bad Bunny Trademarks His Birth Name — Is a Fashion Line or a New Era Coming?
articles.summary: At the Met Gala, Bad Bunny debuted a "Benito Antonio" logo while dressed as an abuelo. Trademark filings suggest he may launch a clothing brand under his given name, sparking fan theories.
